points.title: 童年学艺
points.description: 梅兰芳出生于北京的一个京剧世家，祖父梅巧玲是同治、光绪时期的著名京剧旦角。自幼受家庭熏陶，6岁开始学戏，9岁拜吴菱仙为师，学习青衣行当。这一时期，他接受了严格的京剧基本功训练，包括唱、念、做、打等各个方面，为日后成为京剧大师奠定了坚实基础。在北京的童年学习经历，不仅让他掌握了传统京剧的精髓，也培养了他对艺术的执着追求。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a famous Peking Opera family in Beijing, Mei Lanfang was influenced by his grandfather Mei Qiaoling, a renowned dan role performer during the Tongzhi and Guangxu eras. He began learning opera at age 6 and formally apprenticed to Wu Lingxiang at age 9, specializing in the dan role. During this period, he received rigorous training in all aspects of Peking Opera, including singing, recitation, acting, and acrobatics, laying the foundation for his future mastery. His childhood learning experience in Beijing not only allowed him to master the essence of traditional Peking Opera but also cultivated his persistent pursuit of artistic excellence.

points.title: 崭露头角
points.description: 1904年，梅兰芳首次登台演出，饰演《天女散花》中的仙女。1910年后，他逐渐在京剧界崭露头角，形成了独特的艺术风格。这一时期，他不仅继承了传统京剧的表演艺术，还大胆创新，将昆曲、舞蹈等艺术形式融入京剧表演中，丰富了京剧的表现力。1913年，他在北京演出《贵妃醉酒》，一炮而红，奠定了他在京剧界的地位。在北京的成长阶段，梅兰芳逐渐形成了自己独特的表演风格，为日后成为京剧大师奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1904, Mei Lanfang made his stage debut, playing a fairy in 'The Heavenly Scattering of Flowers.' After 1910, he gradually emerged as a rising star in the Peking Opera world, developing a unique artistic style. During this period, he not only inherited traditional Peking Opera performance techniques but also boldly innovated by incorporating elements of Kunqu opera and dance into his performances, enriching the expressive power of Peking Opera. In 1913, his performance in 'Drunken Concubine' brought him widespread fame, establishing his position in the Peking Opera community. His formative years in Beijing saw the development of his distinctive performing style, laying the groundwork for his future mastery.

points.title: 艺术创新
points.description: 1913年，梅兰芳首次赴上海演出，在上海的舞台上一举成名。他在上海期间，接触到了西方文化和艺术，开阔了艺术视野。这一时期，他大胆改革京剧表演，创造了'梅派'艺术风格，形成了独特的唱腔和表演技巧。他创新了《霸王别姬》、《贵妃醉酒》等经典剧目，将京剧艺术推向了新的高度。在上海的艺术创新阶段，梅兰芳不仅丰富了京剧的表现形式，还吸收了西方戏剧的元素，使京剧艺术更加现代化、国际化，为京剧的发展开辟了新的道路。
points.descriptionEn: In 1913, Mei Lanfang first performed in Shanghai, where he achieved immediate success. During his time in Shanghai, he was exposed to Western culture and art, broadening his artistic horizons. This period saw him boldly reforming Peking Opera performances, creating the 'Mei School' of art with distinctive vocal styles and acting techniques. He innovated classic plays such as 'Farewell My Concubine' and 'Drunken Concubine,' elevating Peking Opera to new artistic heights. His innovative phase in Shanghai not only enriched the expressive forms of Peking Opera but also incorporated elements of Western theater, making the art form more modern and international, opening new paths for its development.

points.title: 艺术巅峰
points.description: 1922年后，梅兰芳回到北京，进入艺术创作的巅峰时期。这一时期，他主演了《洛神》、《太真外传》、《穆桂英挂帅》等经典剧目，形成了完整的'梅派'艺术体系。他不仅注重表演技巧的精湛，更追求人物内心的刻画，使京剧表演达到了前所未有的艺术高度。1930年，梅兰芳访问美国，在纽约、芝加哥等地演出，引起轰动，成为第一位将京剧艺术推向世界的中国艺术家。在北京的艺术巅峰阶段，梅兰芳不仅巩固了自己在京剧界的地位，还将京剧艺术推向了国际舞台，使世界认识了中国的传统艺术。
points.descriptionEn: After 1922, Mei Lanfang returned to Beijing, entering the peak period of his artistic creation. During this time, he starred in classic plays such as 'Goddess of the Luo River,' 'The Romance of Yang Guifei,' and 'Mu Guiying Takes Command,' forming a complete 'Mei School' artistic system. He not only focused on exquisite performance skills but also pursued the portrayal of characters' inner emotions, elevating Peking Opera to unprecedented artistic heights. In 1930, Mei Lanfang visited the United States, performing in New York, Chicago, and other cities, causing a sensation and becoming the first Chinese artist to introduce Peking Opera to the world. During his artistic peak in Beijing, Mei Lanfang not only solidified his position in the Peking Opera community but also brought the art form to the international stage, introducing traditional Chinese art to the world.

points.title: 抗战坚守
points.description: 抗日战争爆发后，梅兰芳拒绝为日伪政权演出，蓄须明志，表现出崇高的民族气节。这一时期，他虽然被迫减少舞台演出，但仍然坚持艺术创作，整理和改编传统剧目，培养后辈艺人。1941年，上海沦陷后，梅兰芳更是闭门谢客，以卖画为生，坚决不为侵略者演出。在上海的抗战坚守阶段，梅兰芳表现出了艺术家的民族气节和爱国情怀，他的行为激励了无数中国人，成为民族精神的象征。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War, Mei Lanfang refused to perform for the Japanese puppet regime, growing a beard to express his determination, demonstrating noble national integrity. Although he was forced to reduce stage performances during this period, he continued his artistic work, organizing and adapting traditional plays while training younger artists. After Shanghai fell in 1941, Mei Lanfang closed his doors to the public, making a living by selling paintings, resolutely refusing to perform for the invaders. During his resistance period in Shanghai, Mei Lanfang demonstrated the national integrity and patriotic spirit of an artist, inspiring countless Chinese people and becoming a symbol of national spirit.

points.title: 晚年贡献
points.description: 新中国成立后，梅兰芳积极参与社会主义文化建设，担任中国戏曲研究院院长等职，致力于京剧艺术的传承与发展。他整理改编传统剧目，培养新一代京剧人才，推动京剧艺术的现代化。1956年，梅兰芳率团访问日本，促进中日文化交流。1959年，加入中国共产党，表现出对新中国文艺事业的忠诚。在北京的晚年阶段，梅兰芳不仅继续艺术创作，还致力于京剧艺术的传承与发展，为新中国文化建设做出了重要贡献。1961年，梅兰芳在北京逝世，享年67岁，为中国京剧艺术留下了宝贵的遗产。
points.descriptionEn: After the founding of New China, Mei Lanfang actively participated in socialist cultural construction, serving as president of the Chinese Traditional Opera Research Institute and dedicating himself to the inheritance and development of Peking Opera. He organized and adapted traditional plays, trained a new generation of Peking Opera talents, and promoted the modernization of the art form. In 1956, Mei Lanfang led a troupe to Japan, promoting cultural exchange between China and Japan. In 1959, he joined the Communist Party of China, showing his loyalty to the cause of New China's literature and art. During his later years in Beijing, Mei Lanfang not only continued his artistic work but also dedicated himself to the inheritance and development of Peking Opera, making significant contributions to New China's cultural construction. He passed away in Beijing in 1961 at the age of 67, leaving a precious legacy for Chinese Peking Opera art.

supporter.zh: 梅兰芳是中国京剧艺术的集大成者，他将京剧旦角表演艺术推向了前所未有的高度。他创造的'梅派'艺术体系，融合了传统与创新，形成了独特的表演风格，对后世京剧发展产生了深远影响。梅兰芳不仅是一位杰出的表演艺术家，更是一位文化使者，将京剧艺术推向世界舞台，让世界认识了中国传统艺术的魅力。他的艺术成就和民族气节，使他成为中国现代文化史上的重要人物。
supporter.en: Mei Lanfang was the consummate master of Chinese Peking Opera, elevating the dan role performance to unprecedented heights. His 'Mei School' artistic system, blending tradition with innovation, created a distinctive performing style that profoundly influenced later generations of Peking Opera. Not only was he an outstanding performing artist, but also a cultural ambassador who introduced Peking Opera to the world stage, allowing the world to appreciate the charm of traditional Chinese art. His artistic achievements and national integrity make him a significant figure in modern Chinese cultural history.

critic.zh: 批评者认为梅兰芳的艺术创新过于西化，削弱了京剧的传统特色。有人指出他在表演中过度强调个人风格，有时偏离了京剧的传统规范。此外，梅兰芳在政治上的立场也受到质疑，特别是他与新政权的关系，以及他在文革前夕的某些表态。这些批评者认为，梅兰芳的艺术成就虽然卓越，但在某些方面也反映了中国传统艺术在现代转型过程中的矛盾与困境。
critic.en: Critics argue that Mei Lanfang's artistic innovations were overly Westernized, weakening the traditional characteristics of Peking Opera. Some point out that his excessive emphasis on personal style sometimes deviated from traditional Peking Opera norms. Additionally, his political stance has been questioned, particularly his relationship with the new regime and certain statements made before the Cultural Revolution. These critics believe that while Mei Lanfang's artistic achievements were remarkable, they also reflected the contradictions and dilemmas of traditional Chinese art during its modern transformation.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，梅兰芳已成为中国传统文化的重要象征。他不仅是京剧艺术的代表人物，更是中国文化软实力的先驱。在流行文化中，梅兰芳的形象被不断重塑，成为连接传统与现代的桥梁。学术界普遍认为，梅兰芳的艺术成就超越了单纯的表演技巧，代表了中国传统艺术在现代语境下的创造性转化。他的生平和艺术实践，为理解中国文化在现代转型中的适应与创新提供了重要案例。
objective.en: From historical and popular cultural perspectives, Mei Lanfang has become an important symbol of traditional Chinese culture. He is not only a representative figure of Peking Opera but also a pioneer of China's cultural soft power. In popular culture, Mei Lanfang's image has been continuously reshaped, serving as a bridge between tradition and modernity. Academically, it is widely recognized that Mei Lanfang's artistic achievements transcend mere performance techniques, representing the creative transformation of traditional Chinese art in a modern context. His life and artistic practice provide an important case study for understanding the adaptation and innovation of Chinese culture during its modern transformation.

self.zh: 艺术的生命在于创新，但创新不能脱离传统。
self.en: The life of art lies in innovation, but innovation cannot be separated from tradition.

others.zh: 梅兰芳是中国戏曲史上的一座丰碑，他的艺术成就不仅属于中国，也属于世界。
others.en: Mei Lanfang is a monumental figure in the history of Chinese opera. His artistic achievements belong not only to China but to the world.
